user.title: Connect to Raritan PDU
user.description: Enter the address and credentials for the PDU. The integration uses HTTPS by default.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Raritan PDU at {host}
reauth_confirm.description: The PDU at {host} rejected your stored credentials. Enter the current username and password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Raritan PDU at {host}
reconfigure.description: Update the address, credentials, or TLS settings. The PDU serial must match the originally configured device.

error.ca_bundle_not_found: The CA bundle path does not point to a readable .pem, .crt, or .cer file
error.invalid_host: The host is not a valid hostname or IP address

abort.invalid_host: The discovered address is not a valid hostname or IP address
abort.reauth_serial_mismatch: The PDU at this address has a different serial than the one originally configured. Aborted to prevent silent device swap.
abort.reconfigure_serial_mismatch: The PDU at this address has a different serial than the one originally configured. Aborted to prevent silent device swap.

tls_verification_disabled.title: TLS verification disabled for {host}
tls_verification_disabled.description: TLS certificate verification is disabled for the Raritan PDU at {host}. Anyone on the network path could intercept credentials. Re-enable verification or provide a CA bundle in the integration options.

firmware_below_minimum.title: Raritan firmware {firmware} is below minimum {minimum}
firmware_below_minimum.description: The PDU firmware {firmware} is older than the minimum supported version {minimum}. Update the PDU firmware via Xerus to use this integration.

pdu_unreachable_extended.title: Raritan PDU unreachable for {minutes} minutes
pdu_unreachable_extended.description: The PDU at {host} has been unreachable for {minutes} minutes. Check network, power, and credentials.

cannot_resolve_outlet.message: Cannot resolve {entity_id} to a Raritan outlet.

cannot_resolve_sensor.message: Cannot resolve {entity_id} to a Raritan sensor.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Raritan PDU for {entity_id} is not loaded; check the integration is set up and reachable.

cycle_outlet.name: Cycle outlet
cycle_outlet.description: Power-cycle a Raritan PDU outlet (off then on with the PDU's configured delay).

set_outlet_state.name: Set outlet state
set_outlet_state.description: Explicitly set a Raritan PDU outlet to ON or OFF.

state.name: State
state.description: Whether the outlet should be ON (true) or OFF (false).

reset_energy_counter.name: Reset energy counter
reset_energy_counter.description: Reset the cumulative energy counter on a Raritan inlet or outlet active_energy sensor.
